title: Ranking lakes for high-chlorophyll events under limited monitoring capacity: data and code
description:
Data and code for ranking lakes for high-chlorophyll events under limited monitoring capacity. The US evaluation covers 2,844 lakes and 130 fortnightly rounds during 2021–2025. The primary lead window is 31–60 days, with absolute events defined at chlorophyll a ≥75 μg/L. Regional analyses also evaluate lake-specific historical thresholds.

The analysis includes source preparation, fitted models, prediction replay, independent-event evaluation, monitoring schedules, uncertainty draws, four main figures, six supplementary figures and a graphical abstract. The complete data-and-code archive is available as lake-biomass-coverage.zip in GitHub release v2.0.0. It includes processed inputs, models, scores, events, results and figure sources. Original bulk downloads are obtained from the providers listed in docs/data_sources.csv.
